name: 14468 · Hilton, NY
findings: ZIP 14468 (Hilton) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14468 (Hilton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 14468 (Hilton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
